{{Clue info
|id = 967
|text = The cryptic reveals where to search:<br><br>Search the food barrel{{sic}} at the top of the Hunter Guild

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 15 May 2024
|update = Further Project Rebalance (Skilling) & Varlamore Changes
|change = 
* The location of the clue has been changed from searching a certain bookshelf in [[the Burrow]] to searching a food barrel at the top of the guild's tree, removing the level 46 [[Hunter]] requirement that was deemed too high for easy Treasure Trails.
* The clue description has been changed; previously, it was ''Search the bookshelf with a skull on it inside the Burrow.''
}}
